**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is looking for project management tools to help organize tasks more efficiently.  
[EVENT] The user has been working on a proposal for a new project on Thursday.  
[TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/30 (Tue) at 10:51.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended several project management tools: Trello, Asana, Basecamp, Wrike, ClickUp, Microsoft Planner, and Airtable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello is a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to organize tasks and has a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana is a task-oriented tool that helps create and assign tasks, set deadlines, and track progress, suitable for small to large teams, with a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basecamp is a comprehensive project management tool that includes schedules, tasks, files, and collaboration tools, geared towards small to medium-sized teams, and offers a free trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wrike is a robust project management tool that includes Gantt charts, resource allocation, and time tracking, suitable for larger teams, and offers a free trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ClickUp is an all-in-one project management tool that includes tasks, Gantt charts, time tracking, and collaboration features, suitable for small to large teams, with a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft Planner is a task management tool that integrates with Microsoft Office 365, great for small to medium-sized teams, included with an Office 365 subscription.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Airtable is a cloud-based database that allows creating custom tables, forms, and views to manage projects, suitable for small to medium-sized teams, with a free version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana features include tasks and subtasks, projects and templates, workflows, due dates and reminders, assignments and roles, collaboration, reporting and dashboards, integrations, and mobile apps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana pricing includes a free version for small teams (up to 15 users), Premium at $9.99/user/month, Business at $19.99/user/month, and Enterprise with custom pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana offers discounts for annual billing (10% off), non-profit organizations (50% off), and educational institutions (50% off).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana has a built-in time tracking feature that allows users to log time spent on tasks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested creating a task for each section of the user's proposal and breaking down each section into smaller tasks.
